request: We want a simple mobile money wallet service for the customers of our shop in Accra. A customer opens a wallet with their name and phone number, and one phone number can only have one wallet. Customers can put money into their own wallet and send money from their wallet to someone else's wallet. Amounts are in Ghana cedis and pesewas, so never more than two decimal places, and every amount must be more than zero. Nobody can send more than they have, so a wallet's balance must never go below zero, and sending money to your own wallet is not allowed. The money must add up to the exact pesewa every time, with no rounding mistakes. We want to check any wallet's balance and see its history of every deposit and transfer, showing the amount and what the balance was right after each one.
summary:
I've built the wallet service in `app.py`, and all 20 automated tests pass. Data is saved in a file called `wallet.db` in the same folder.

**What you can do:**

| Action | Address | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| Open a wallet | `POST /wallets` with `{"name": "Ama", "phone": "0241234567"}` | Creates a wallet that starts at 0.00. A phone number that already has a wallet is refused. |
| Check a balance | `GET /wallets/{id}` | Shows the wallet's name, phone number and balance. |
| Put money in | `POST /wallets/{id}/deposits` with `{"amount": "10.50"}` | Adds the money and returns the new balance. |
| Send money | `POST /wallets/{id}/transfers` with `{"to_wallet_id": 2, "amount": "5.00"}` | Moves money to another wallet. |
| See the history | `GET /wallets/{id}/history` | Lists every deposit, money sent and money received, oldest first. Each line shows the amount, the balance right after it and the other wallet involved. |

**Rules it enforces:**
- **One wallet per phone number:** the service treats `0241234567` and `+233241234567` as the same number, so a customer can't open a second wallet by typing their number a different way.
- **Valid amounts only:** an amount must be more than zero and have no more than two decimal places. Zero, negative amounts, `1.234` and text are refused.
- **No overdrawing:** you can't send more than the wallet holds, so a balance never goes below zero. Sending your exact full balance is allowed.
- **No sending to yourself:** a transfer to your own wallet is refused.
- **Wallet must exist:** if a wallet ID doesn't exist, you get a "not found" message.
- **Exact to the pesewa:** money is stored as whole pesewas, so nothing is ever rounded. For example, ten deposits of 0.10 always add up to exactly 1.00. Amounts come back as text like `"12.50"` so they show exactly.

**Things to know before you use it:**
- **No logins:** the service doesn't check who is making a request. Anyone who can reach it can deposit into or send from any wallet if they know its number. You didn't ask for logins, so I didn't add them, but you will need some form of sign-in before real customers use this.
- **Phone number check:** a phone number must be 9 to 15 digits, optionally starting with `+`.
- **Size limit:** a single amount can't be more than 1 trillion cedis. I added this limit so the numbers always fit in the database.
